title: PDP / buybox - Benefits box
summary: A benefits display box showing delivery info, shipping costs, and customizable benefit items with icons.
features: Conditional delivery info display based on free shipping
Support for links in benefit descriptions
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Benefits Box component displays shipping and benefit information with customizable icons to reinforce value propositions and build purchase confidence. It communicates key selling points such as free returns, warranty information, and delivery details in a scannable format.

## Use Cases

- Displaying shipping and benefit information with customizable icons
- Showing product-specific delivery costs based on product categories
- Hiding redundant delivery information when free shipping applies
- Communicating trust signals like secure payment and easy returns

## Design Rationale

The component uses icons paired with concise text to create easily scannable benefit highlights. Conditional logic hides delivery cost information when free shipping applies, avoiding redundant messaging. Support for product group-specific shipping costs accommodates stores with varied fulfillment requirements such as bulky goods versus standard items. The flexible number of benefits allows stores to emphasize their unique value propositions.
